title: Quaint Gooey Ethiopian Macaroni Fir Fir
description: A cultured and gooey lacto-vegetarian Ethiopian dish featuring macaroni, this crowd-pleaser is sure to satisfy your cravings. It is a unique twist on traditional fir fir, with a creamy and tangy sauce.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the macaroni according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the berbere spice and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the tomato paste to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the yogurt and cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Add the cooked macaroni to the skillet and toss with the sauce until well coated.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the macaroni hot, topped with additional yogurt and berbere spice if desired.
